claim: Milestone 2A frozen campaign specification for the four-seed comparison of INT8 post-training quantization and PGD adversarial training in the PAVE Standard Transformer. Specified here and NOT run in M2A. This is a new group-disjoint evaluation partition within a previously examined dataset, not a completely untouched external benchmark.

step0.description: Budget-adequacy step that must finish before any other campaign unit runs.
steps: train seed-1 V1 and V3 for 25 epochs on the full M2 train partition
derive V2 and V4 by INT8 PTQ with the frozen calibration rows
run the E4 comparison pgd20 vs pgd50x5 in 12 paired cells (V1 and V3 with fp32_direct, V2 and V4 with bpda_int8, epsilon 0.025, 0.05, 0.10) on the validation E4 subset
stop and ask the user if the E4 subset has fewer than 1000 rows
freeze the attack budget in configs/m2/attacks.json (status frozen) and record its SHA-256 in a new campaign.json revision
only then run seeds 7, 13 and 29 and all attack cells
step0.budget_rule: pgd20 is adequate if n_extra <= ceil(0.01 * n_subset) in every one of the 12 cells; otherwise pgd50x5 is used for every model, source and epsilon
step0.freeze: attacks.json hash is not part of this revision; after step 0 a new campaign.json revision stores the frozen attacks.json hash and --confirm-freeze must match that revision

derivation.V3: PGD adversarial training, fresh initialisation, same seed

diagnostics: per-example union row over INT8 sources, separately labelled

optional_v5_arms.status: optional; not run in M2A; QAT benefit is attributed only relative to FP32-FT->PTQ

matrix.aggregation: mean and standard deviation over the four seeds with per-seed values kept; paired differences V3 vs V1 and V4 vs V2 per seed; no significance claim beyond the spread
matrix.perturbation_structure: row-tied (primary); per-position mode only as a labelled sensitivity check on seed 1

phases.m2a: bounded pilot (research.m2_pilot); train and validation data only
phases.m2b_validation: campaign on train and validation data only; not implemented in M2A
phases.m2b_test: single test evaluation after all configs are frozen and hashed; needs --confirm-freeze equal to the SHA-256 of this file; belongs to a later milestone

post_step0_note: pgd20 stays provisional until step 0 decides the budget
